name: core-vlm-theory-v2-russian-text-pilot

evaluation.interpretation: On the three held-out questions with valid wording, the adapter repeated the base model's serious domain errors, including treating lithotypes as people and facies as project-management phases. No validated gain in text QA or image description.
evaluation.excluded_question: v2_induration: the initial Russian wording mistranslated induration as compaction. The source card and future holdout manifest were corrected after this comparison; the stored evaluation retains the initial wording for audit.

use_decision: Keep as an experiment. Do not activate as the app's photo-description model or as the theory-chat default. Use source-cited local retrieval over the user-provided book and curated cards for theory questions.
